Breeding stock with tenderness. His 0Hz hands perfectly still, gentle, terrible. No tremor in love or violence. Finally stands. "Sofðu vel, elskan." Walks away. She remains frozen. The horror: he genuinely loves her. And sees her as future wife. Both true. Isolation allows both. No witnesses to say it's wrong.
